title: Heavyweight models drop the paywall
summary:
We moved top-tier models like GPT-5.4 and FLUX.1 to the free tier, stabilized text generation, and merged a massive wave of 20 new community apps.

We consolidated some backend providers and used the efficiency gains to move a massive chunk of our premium models to the free tier. GPT-5.4, Grok, Qwen Coder, gptimage-large, and FLUX.1 Kontext are now freely accessible. We also wired up Mistral-Large-3 and Grok-4-20, because why not.

The showcase directory exploded today. The community shipped native clients for Mac (Warden) and Android (PerChamp), a zero-dependency HTML playground (Dreamframe), and a SillyTavern avatar generator. The rest of the haul includes everything from philosophical text analyzers and emoji-to-image generators to botanical quiz games and screenshot deconstructors. The ecosystem is buzzing.

Azure's gateways were buckling under the concurrent load for Kimi and DeepSeek, resulting in failed requests. We rerouted both models through Fireworks to restore stability. Text generation for these models is back to being reliable.

highlights.title: Heavyweight models hit the free tier
highlights.text: GPT-5.4, Grok, and Qwen Coder are now free to use. We also wired up Mistral-Large-3 and Grok-4-20 to the [text endpoint](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Premium pixels, zero cost
highlights.text: `gptimage-large` and `FLUX.1 Kontext` have been moved off the paid tier. Send a prompt, get high-quality pixels back.

highlights.title: Dreamframe
highlights.text: A zero-dependency, single-HTML-file playground for testing image, video, voice, and music generation. View source, learn, steal. [Try it](https://funniman23.github.io/Dreamframe/)

highlights.title: SillyTavern avatar generation
highlights.text: A new extension lets you generate and update character avatars via our image API directly inside your local LLM frontend. [View repo](https://github.com/sunjichaocom/pollinations-avatar-gen-reforged)

highlights.title: Warden App
highlights.text: A lightweight, privacy-focused native SwiftUI client for Mac users who want to chat with our models without the Electron overhead. [View repo](https://github.com/SidhuK/WardenApp)

highlights.title: Community app explosion
highlights.text: The greenhouse is overflowing with 15+ new submissions this week, including emoji-to-image generators, botanical quizzes, and social video creators. [View apps](https://hello.pollinations.ai)
